title: tech4health: EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Digital Health Technologies
about: Ulster University lists PhD studentships in the tech4health EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Digital Health Technologies, run with University College London. Submissions are due Friday 29 January 2027 at 4:00 PM; interviews are in February 2027.
requirements: First or Upper Second Class Honours Degree in a relevant subject, or equivalent (e.g. Lower Second plus a Master's with Distinction)

upskill.name: the Data Analytics Academy page
why: Field "Digital health technologies, engineering" → Data Analytics Academy course A005.15 objective "Explore healthcare and clinical analytics applications involving electronic health records, genomics, and epidemiological data" (A005.15 is not on the scored shortlist, so the Academy page is linked rather than the course).

card_alt: Card for tech4health: EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Digital Health Technologies at Ulster University, United Kingdom, deadline 29 Jan 2027. The photo shows Big Ben and Westminster Bridge in London, an illustrative UK landmark, not the university's location.
